verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email service, but every piece of evidence describes AgentMail as a hosted API (hosted MCP endpoint, API-key registration against AgentMail's service). Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment. A community comment presents a third-party tool as the 'self-hosted drop-in replacement', which implies AgentMail itself is not self-hostable. Custom domains give control over sending reputation, not over the mail pipeline.
